paragraphs: AffordableHousing.com runs an online rental marketplace for people looking for low income, subsidized and Section 8 housing. The company calls itself the largest online marketplace for affordable housing in the country.

Registration is free for renters and opens up listing details, online applications, waiting list updates, saved searches and new listing alerts. On the other side, property owners post units to reach renters and the housing agencies that support them. Reference pages explain that Section 8, also called the Housing Choice Voucher program, covers part of a renter's monthly rent. Other pages point renters to the local housing authorities that review applications, check eligibility and issue vouchers.

The company says its partnerships since 2003 include HUD, thousands of government agencies and property owners nationwide. It states that housing agencies have partnered with it since 2005. The site publishes reviews from renters and property managers alongside its listings.

quote.text: AffordableHousing.com is the nation’s largest online marketplace for affordable housing.
